comment: The control mapping of the WinUI theme port (docs/porting/winui-theme.md, section 6). `ferroui`: every document of the Fluent theme (src/FerroUI.Themes.Fluent/Controls), the default control themes it defines ({Type}), the WinUI 3 styles and resources the WinUI theme builds them from, and the work batch that ports it. `winui`: every target type of a WinUI style of the merged theme, the FerroUI control its implicit style themes (null: no FerroUI control; the waivers say why), and the batch. Read by scripts/winui-theme/status.py, which renders both tables into the design document.

batches.F: Foundation: the crate, the resources, the window and popup hosts, and the button, check box, radio button, text box and scroll viewer families
batches.B5: Navigation, pages, tabs and command bar
batches.B6: Window decorations, notifications, tables and dialogs

document_batches.comment: The batch of the styles of a source document (a prefix of its path, or path#key for one style), before the batch of their target type: the keyed styles of the documents of a control belong to the batch of that control.

ferroui.winui: No WinUI style: the system focus visual of WinUI (FocusVisualPrimaryBrush/Thickness, FocusVisualSecondaryBrush/Thickness; the SystemControlFocusVisual* resources of Common_themeresources.xaml).
No WinUI control: the spin buttons of NumberBox (NumberBoxSpinButtonStyle, NumberBox.xaml) and the TextBox resources.
The month and year items of CalendarView (CalendarViewBaseItem resources of CalendarView_themeresources.xaml).
The header, navigation buttons and views of the CalendarView template (DefaultCalendarViewStyle).
No WinUI control: built from FlipView (DefaultFlipViewStyle) and the page background (SolidBackgroundFillColorBaseBrush).

CommandBar: DefaultCommandBarStyle, DefaultCommandBarOverflowPresenterStyle (CommandBar_themeresources.xaml); AppBarButton: DefaultAppBarButtonStyle, AppBarButtonOverflowStyle; AppBarToggleButton: DefaultAppBarToggleButtonStyle, AppBarToggleButtonOverflowStyle; AppBarSeparator: DefaultAppBarSeparatorStyle.
No WinUI style (Page has none): the page background and text of the window (SolidBackgroundFillColorBaseBrush, TextFillColorPrimaryBrush).

No WinUI style (input validation was removed from WinUI 3): the critical fill of the palette (SystemFillColorCriticalBrush) for the message and the border of the field, and the error icon of InfoBar (InfoBar.xaml, InfoBar_themeresources.xaml) for the tool tip variant.
No WinUI control: the pane of NavigationView (NavigationView_themeresources.xaml) and SplitView (DefaultSplitViewStyle).
No WinUI style: the background and text of the window (SolidBackgroundFillColorBaseBrush, TextFillColorPrimaryBrush, ContentControlThemeFontFamily, ControlContentThemeFontSize).

No WinUI control in the merged theme: built from the control fills of the palette (ControlStrongFillColorDefaultBrush, ControlStrongFillColorDisabledBrush) and the accent fill for the preview (AccentFillColorDefaultBrush).
No WinUI control: an expanded Expander without its chevron (DefaultExpanderStyle, Expander.xaml; the header of ExpanderHeaderDownStyle, Expander_themeresources.xaml).
No WinUI style: the header presenter of the WinUI controls with a Header (TextBox: HeaderContentPresenter, TextBoxTopHeaderMargin, TextControlHeaderForeground).
No WinUI style in the merged theme (ItemsControl has a built-in template): an ItemsPresenter of the ItemsPanel.
No WinUI control: the implicit style of ContentControl ({ContentControl}, generic.xaml), which Controls/Label.xaml ports.
No WinUI control: built from the ListViewItem (ListViewItem_themeresources.xaml), TextBox, Button and ContentDialog (DefaultContentDialogStyle) styles.

MenuFlyoutItem: DefaultMenuFlyoutItemStyle; MenuFlyoutSubItem: DefaultMenuFlyoutSubItemStyle; ToggleMenuFlyoutItem: DefaultToggleMenuFlyoutItemStyle (MenuFlyout_themeresources.xaml); RadioMenuFlyoutItem: DefaultRadioMenuFlyoutItemStyle (RadioMenuFlyoutItem_themeresources.xaml).
The ScrollViewer of the MenuFlyoutPresenter template (MenuFlyout_themeresources.xaml).
No WinUI control: NavigationBackButtonNormalStyle, NavigationBackButtonSmallStyle (NavigationBackButton.xaml) and the page background.
No WinUI style: the text of the window (TextFillColorPrimaryBrush, ContentControlThemeFontFamily, ControlContentThemeFontSize).
No WinUI style (IconElement has no template): the Path that WinUI's PathIcon builds in code (CPathIcon::ApplyTemplate, icon.cpp), unscaled and filled with the Foreground.

No WinUI style (IconElement has no template): the TextBlock that WinUI's FontIcon builds in code (CFontIcon::ApplyTemplate, icon.cpp), in the font SymbolThemeFontFamily. A WinUI control in ferroui-controls (docs/porting/winui-controls.md); the Fluent theme has no document for it.

No WinUI style (IconElement has no template): the TextBlock that WinUI's SymbolIcon builds in code (CSymbolIcon::ApplyTemplate, icon.cpp), 20 px, in the font SymbolThemeFontFamily. A WinUI control in ferroui-controls (docs/porting/winui-controls.md); the Fluent theme has no document for it.

PipsPager: {PipsPager} (PipsPager.xaml), PipsPagerNavigationButtonBaseStyle, PipsPagerPreviousPageButtonStyle, PipsPagerNextPageButtonStyle, PipsPagerButtonBaseStyle, PipsPagerSelectedPipButtonStyle, PipsPagerNormalPipButtonStyle (PipsPager_themeresources.xaml).
No WinUI style: the text of the window (TextFillColorPrimaryBrush, ContentControlThemeFontFamily, ControlContentThemeFontSize).
No WinUI control (TextBlock.IsTextSelectionEnabled): the selection colours of the text selection manager of WinUI (SystemControlHighlightAccentBrush, SystemColorHighlightTextColor).
MenuFlyoutSeparator: {MenuFlyoutSeparator} (MenuFlyout_themeresources.xaml); AppBarSeparator for a separator in a command bar.

No WinUI control: NavigationView with its pane at the top (TopNavArea of NavigationView.xaml, MUX_NavigationViewItemPresenterStyleWhenOnTopPane of NavigationView_themeresources.xaml) and the page background.

No control of the merged theme: WinUI's TableView of the tabular library (controls/dev/TableView, TableView_themeresources.xaml, not part of XamlControlsResources) is the closest source; the ListViewItem resources otherwise.
As TableView: the cells of controls/dev/TableView.
As TableView: the column headers of controls/dev/TableView and SortIndicator.
As TableView: the rows of controls/dev/TableView; the ListViewItem resources.

TextBox: DefaultTextBoxStyle and its DeleteButtonStyle (TextBox_themeresources.xaml); PasswordBox: DefaultPasswordBoxStyle (PasswordBox_themeresources.xaml), a keyed theme with the reveal button; the context flyout of TextCommandBarFlyout as a menu flyout (B3).
No WinUI style (the selection grippers are drawn in code, Gripper.cpp): the gripper circles in SystemColorWindowColor outlined in TextControlSelectionHighlightColor.
No WinUI style: the text foreground (TextFillColorPrimaryBrush).
No WinUI style: the template of ContentControl ({ContentControl}, generic.xaml), twice, for the page transition of the control.

No WinUI style (Window is not a control in WinUI 3): the Mica fallback background and text of a window (SolidBackgroundFillColorBaseBrush, TextFillColorPrimaryBrush, ContentControlThemeFontFamily, ControlContentThemeFontSize).
TitleBar: DefaultTitleBarStyle (TitleBar.xaml, TitleBar_themeresources.xaml); WindowCaptionButton (generic.xaml) for the caption buttons.
No WinUI control: a host of InfoBar cards (InfoBar_themeresources.xaml).

ButtonBase.note: keyed styles of the date and time picker flyouts and TextBlockButtonStyle

CommandBarOverflowPresenter.note: the overflow presenter is part of the CommandBar template in FerroUI

ContentControl.note: ContentControl has a built-in template in FerroUI; Label is built from it and claims the implicit style

ContentPresenter.note: FerroUI's ContentPresenter is not templated; the implicit style is waived

FlipViewItem.note: the items of a Carousel are its content presenters

ListViewItem.note: the keyed ListViewItem styles; the implicit one has no FerroUI control (no ListView)

LoopingSelector.note: the looping lists of the date and time picker presenters; FerroUI's DateTimePickerPanel is a panel, not templated, so the selectors are part of the DatePickerPresenter and TimePickerPresenter themes

LoopingSelectorItem.note: the items of the date and time picker presenters

MenuBarItem.note: the top-level items of a Menu

NavigationViewItem.note: keyed styles only; NavigationView has no FerroUI control

NavigationView.note: no FerroUI control; DrawerPage is built from its pane

PasswordBox.note: FerroUI's TextBox with a PasswordChar; ported as the keyed DefaultPasswordBoxStyle

Rectangle.note: keyed styles of template parts (ComboBoxItemPill, SelectorBarItemPill)

SplitMenuFlyoutItem.note: no FerroUI counterpart: MenuItem has no split mode (waived)

TextBlock.note: keyed styles (BodyTextBlockStyle, ...) become keyed control themes of TextBlock

Thumb.note: the default theme of FerroUI's Thumb (the thumbs of ScrollBar and Slider have keyed themes)

ToggleSplitButton.note: FerroUI's ToggleSplitButton overrides its style key to SplitButton
